name: gizza-ai/ed25519-key-pair-generator
summary: Generate an Ed25519 key pair (PEM + raw)

tool.description: Generate a fresh Ed25519 key pair and return the private key (PKCS#8 PEM), the public key (SPKI PEM), and both raw 32-byte keys in base64 and hex. Keys are generated locally with a cryptographic RNG (getrandom). Ed25519 is a fast, modern EdDSA signature scheme used by SSH, OpenPGP, JWT (EdDSA), and TLS.
